CVE-2026-114437 (GHSA-j6qf-3m9c-vwj3): in github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 before v5.4.0, the ClientIPFromXFF middleware skips X-Forwarded-For entries inside a configured trusted CIDR without checking that the direct TCP peer is in that CIDR, so a client that reaches the server directly can choose the IP that middleware.GetClientIP returns. Commit 7f9b744, first released in v5.4.0, changes ClientIPFromHeader and ClientIPFromXFF in middleware/client_ip.go to use the direct TCP peer's address when that peer is outside the trusted prefixes, and moves the address parsing of ClientIPFromRemoteAddr into a shared helper; GetClientIP, which only returns the IP those middlewares store, is unchanged. The client-IP middlewares first appeared in v5.3.0: https://github.com/go-chi/chi/security/advisories/GHSA-j6qf-3m9c-vwj3, https://github.com/go-chi/chi/commit/7f9b7448f51d28804fac98c0a17bc2a7cec1079f. We checked every published scout-cli-dev package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository: 24 builds, 1.20.4-r1 to the current 1.30.0-r0, on x86_64 and aarch64 (48 packages), each against its index checksum. Each package holds one file, /usr/bin/docker-scout, a Go program with no program interpreter and no shared-library dependencies. Its Go build information lists github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 in every build: v5.2.5 in 1.20.4-r1 to 1.23.1-r0, v5.3.0 in 1.23.1-r1 to 1.23.1-r2, v5.3.1 in 1.23.1-r3 to 1.23.1-r9, v5.3.2 in 1.23.1-r10 to 1.26.0-r2, and v5.5.0 in 1.26.0-r3 to 1.30.0-r0. A Go function-table (pclntab) reader finds chi functions in every build (runtime.main found in the same scan as a control) but none of ClientIPFromXFF, ClientIPFromXFFTrustedProxies, ClientIPFromHeader or ClientIPFromRemoteAddr, or any closure of them, in any build. The builds with chi v5.2.5 contain no client-IP code at all; in every build with chi v5.3.0 or later the only client-IP function is GetClientIP, which chi's request logger calls to read the stored value, and with no client-IP middleware linked nothing stores one. A byte search of every build finds no "ClientIPFromXFF" string, which would remain in the function names if the middleware had been inlined. As a positive control, the same reader and byte search, run on a Go program we built for amd64 and arm64 against chi v5.3.2 that uses ClientIPFromXFF, find ClientIPFromXFF, its closures and GetClientIP. The docker-cli-scout-cli packages built from the same source hold no program code: each of the 24 published docker-cli-scout-cli builds for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository, on x86_64 and aarch64 and checked against its index checksum, contains only a symbolic link, /usr/local/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-scout, pointing to /usr/bin/docker-scout.
